meta.title: New Song Rising
meta.description: The show is over, but the story still continues.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Neural Inspection Lab.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Neural Inspection Lab.

spans.text: The Oasis, Neural Inspection Lab.

units.rawText: After that, I think they toured around a bunch of cities, and performed in a bunch of commercial scenarios.
units.displayText: After that, I think they toured around a bunch of cities, and performed in a bunch of commercial scenarios.

spans.text: After that, I think they toured around a bunch of cities, and performed in a bunch of commercial scenarios.

units.rawText: Until Project Neural Cloud picked them out as a performing arts Doll with experience in a variety of environments.
units.displayText: Until Project Neural Cloud picked them out as a performing arts Doll with experience in a variety of environments.

spans.text: Until Project Neural Cloud picked them out as a performing arts Doll with experience in a variety of environments.

units.rawText: It hasn't been easy for them to get this far, and to be wary of others is only normal.
units.displayText: It hasn't been easy for them to get this far, and to be wary of others is only normal.

spans.text: It hasn't been easy for them to get this far, and to be wary of others is only normal.

units.rawText: Yeah. And when they received neural scans at their previous employer... it didn't turn out so well.
units.displayText: Yeah. And when they received neural scans at their previous employer... it didn't turn out so well.

spans.text: Yeah. And when they received neural scans at their previous employer... it didn't turn out so well.

units.rawText: I think the memory extraction process must have triggered some painful memories for her to have such an intense reaction.
units.displayText: I think the memory extraction process must have triggered some painful memories for her to have such an intense reaction.

spans.text: I think the memory extraction process must have triggered some painful memories for her to have such an intense reaction.

units.rawText: My apologies, Professor. I didn't consider this aspect, and something really bad might have happened.
units.displayText: My apologies, Professor. I didn't consider this aspect, and something really bad might have happened.

spans.text: My apologies, Professor. I didn't consider this aspect, and something really bad might have happened.

units.rawText: Be at ease, De Lacey. This isn't your fault. I must bear part of the responsibility as well for not finding out beforehand and reducing the pain she felt.
units.displayText: Be at ease, De Lacey. This isn't your fault. I must bear part of the responsibility as well for not finding out beforehand and reducing the pain she felt.

spans.text: Be at ease, De Lacey. This isn't your fault. I must bear part of the responsibility as well for not finding out beforehand and reducing the pain she felt.

units.rawText: They'll see the Oasis' integrity in time. I know that they do not understand the Oasis, so only honesty will convince them.
units.displayText: They'll see the Oasis' integrity in time. I know that they do not understand the Oasis, so only honesty will convince them.

spans.text: They'll see the Oasis' integrity in time. I know that they do not understand the Oasis, so only honesty will convince them.

units.rawText: To add onto that, De Lacey... I think that her refusal to stay is out of fear for your standing as a member of the Guardians.
units.displayText: To add onto that, De Lacey... I think that her refusal to stay is out of fear for your standing as a member of the Guardians.

spans.text: To add onto that, De Lacey... I think that her refusal to stay is out of fear for your standing as a member of the Guardians.

units.rawText: Unni, for me...
units.displayText: Unni, for me...

spans.text: Unni, for me...

units.rawText: In truth, I guessed as much. To not be able to put her mind at ease as a technician is truly embarrassing.
units.displayText: In truth, I guessed as much. To not be able to put her mind at ease as a technician is truly embarrassing.

spans.text: In truth, I guessed as much. To not be able to put her mind at ease as a technician is truly embarrassing.

units.rawText: No, you've already done well. It is exactly because of you that she realized just how important irreplaceable companions are in time.
units.displayText: No, you've already done well. It is exactly because of you that she realized just how important irreplaceable companions are in time.

spans.text: No, you've already done well. It is exactly because of you that she realized just how important irreplaceable companions are in time.

units.rawText: I'll explain to Unni later, then. Our Boss, and the Professor, are nowhere close to the type of people she makes them out to be.
units.displayText: I'll explain to Unni later, then. Our Boss, and the Professor, are nowhere close to the type of people she makes them out to be.

spans.text: I'll explain to Unni later, then. Our Boss, and the Professor, are nowhere close to the type of people she makes them out to be.

units.rawText: Hehehe... Worrying about me so much, you're the exact same as before, Unni.
units.displayText: Hehehe... Worrying about me so much, you're the exact same as before, Unni.

spans.text: Hehehe... Worrying about me so much, you're the exact same as before, Unni.

units.rawText: <size=28>Who's the exact same as before... you neurally simple idiot.</size>
units.displayText: Who's the exact same as before... you neurally simple idiot.

spans.text: Who's the exact same as before... you neurally simple idiot.

units.rawText: Eh? Unni? Did you just wake up?
units.displayText: Eh? Unni? Did you just wake up?

spans.text: Eh? Unni? Did you just wake up?

units.rawText: Not just then... You're a bit slow, De Lacey. You stupid philanthropist, with self-awareness like this I'd be shocked if you could make your way through the Null Zones without any hitches.
units.displayText: Not just then... You're a bit slow, De Lacey. You stupid philanthropist, with self-awareness like this I'd be shocked if you could make your way through the Null Zones without any hitches.

spans.text: Not just then... You're a bit slow, De Lacey. You stupid philanthropist, with self-awareness like this I'd be shocked if you could make your way through the Null Zones without any hitches.

units.rawText: About that, Unni... I've got plenty of methods to deal with enemies.
units.displayText: About that, Unni... I've got plenty of methods to deal with enemies.

spans.text: About that, Unni... I've got plenty of methods to deal with enemies.

units.rawText: Hmph... You better, or people will get concerned about you. When we save up enough money, don't you dare be absent.
units.displayText: Hmph... You better, or people will get concerned about you. When we save up enough money, don't you dare be absent.

spans.text: Hmph... You better, or people will get concerned about you. When we save up enough money, don't you dare be absent.

units.rawText: Hehehe, alright, if Unni says so, I'll do everything I can with the research!
units.displayText: Hehehe, alright, if Unni says so, I'll do everything I can with the research!

spans.text: Hehehe, alright, if Unni says so, I'll do everything I can with the research!

units.rawText: You seem to get along well. No matter how strange it may look, you still care for your friends, right Undine?
units.displayText: You seem to get along well. No matter how strange it may look, you still care for your friends, right Undine?

spans.text: You seem to get along well. No matter how strange it may look, you still care for your friends, right Undine?

units.rawText: <size=28>Hmph...</size>
units.displayText: Hmph...

spans.text: Hmph...

units.rawText: But, if you heard our conversation just now, I'm sure you understand, Unni.
units.displayText: But, if you heard our conversation just now, I'm sure you understand, Unni.

spans.text: But, if you heard our conversation just now, I'm sure you understand, Unni.

units.rawText: Our Boss and the Prof here are really nice people, and they won't give us any trouble for something like this.
units.displayText: Our Boss and the Prof here are really nice people, and they won't give us any trouble for something like this.

spans.text: Our Boss and the Prof here are really nice people, and they won't give us any trouble for something like this.

units.rawText: Stupid De Lacey, getting used by someone like that, and still coming to their defense...
units.displayText: Stupid De Lacey, getting used by someone like that, and still coming to their defense...

spans.text: Stupid De Lacey, getting used by someone like that, and still coming to their defense...

units.rawText: Eh? Is that what happened?
units.displayText: Eh? Is that what happened?

spans.text: Eh? Is that what happened?

units.rawText: You knew from the very start that I was awake, right? Professor. These things, did you say them just for me to listen to?
units.displayText: You knew from the very start that I was awake, right? Professor. These things, did you say them just for me to listen to?

spans.text: You knew from the very start that I was awake, right? Professor. These things, did you say them just for me to listen to?

units.rawText: I'll leave that to your own judgment.
units.displayText: I'll leave that to your own judgment.

spans.text: I'll leave that to your own judgment.

units.rawText: See, the Professor's both clever and considerate!
units.displayText: See, the Professor's both clever and considerate!

spans.text: See, the Professor's both clever and considerate!

units.rawText: Unni looks happy, though.
units.displayText: Unni looks happy, though.

spans.text: Unni looks happy, though.

units.displayText: Delusions.

Dididi, beeeep—
(Status, excellent.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—

units.rawText: Right, right? They seem to be in agreement.
units.displayText: Right, right? They seem to be in agreement.

spans.text: Right, right? They seem to be in agreement.

units.rawText: <size=28>Hmph. And, Professor... We also... thank you, yeah.</size>
units.displayText: Hmph. And, Professor... We also... thank you, yeah.

spans.text: Hmph. And, Professor... We also... thank you, yeah.

units.rawText: If it is really as you say, then staying... is not undoable.
units.displayText: If it is really as you say, then staying... is not undoable.

spans.text: If it is really as you say, then staying... is not undoable.

units.rawText: We've been traveling for far too long, and to be able to stay somewhere doesn't sound bad... at the very least, better than continually changing masters and performance venues.
units.displayText: We've been traveling for far too long, and to be able to stay somewhere doesn't sound bad... at the very least, better than continually changing masters and performance venues.

spans.text: We've been traveling for far too long, and to be able to stay somewhere doesn't sound bad... at the very least, better than continually changing masters and performance venues.

(New home, found! Yay!)

units.rawText: Aides exchange signals jubilantly and their main unit turns their face to the side, tinged with a very slight shade of red.
units.displayText: Aides exchange signals jubilantly and their main unit turns their face to the side, tinged with a very slight shade of red.

spans.text: Aides exchange signals jubilantly and their main unit turns their face to the side, tinged with a very slight shade of red.

units.rawText: I extend my hand to this long-suffering, yet proud and resolute conductor.
units.displayText: I extend my hand to this long-suffering, yet proud and resolute conductor.

spans.text: I extend my hand to this long-suffering, yet proud and resolute conductor.

units.rawText: Undine, Dolce, Scherzando, Tranquillo, Maestoso. As a representative of the Oasis, I welcome your arrival.
units.displayText: Undine, Dolce, Scherzando, Tranquillo, Maestoso. As a representative of the Oasis, I welcome your arrival.

spans.text: Undine, Dolce, Scherzando, Tranquillo, Maestoso. As a representative of the Oasis, I welcome your arrival.

units.rawText: This is your new home now. You have no need to drift in the wind anymore.
units.displayText: This is your new home now. You have no need to drift in the wind anymore.

spans.text: This is your new home now. You have no need to drift in the wind anymore.

units.rawText: Undine hesitates briefly, eventually shaking my hand. Resolve and a hint of glee shines from her eyes.
units.displayText: Undine hesitates briefly, eventually shaking my hand. Resolve and a hint of glee shines from her eyes.

spans.text: Undine hesitates briefly, eventually shaking my hand. Resolve and a hint of glee shines from her eyes.
